# GTS Segment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](gmeow-GTSSegment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GTSSegment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

One complete header-plus-frames log inside a GTS document — the unit of independent integrity (spec §3.1): a segment has its own genesis hash, its own id/prev chain, its own profile, its own transform catalog, and its own signers. Segments compose by concatenation and never vouch for one another; a third-party segment keeps its third-party attestation. Itself a [`Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md): a segment is a complete, independently shippable artifact.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](gmeow-GTSSegment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for one independently-verifiable log within a document — the unit that carries its own chain, profile, codec catalog, and signers, and the subject a transport [`Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) vouches for.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the whole file (use [`gmeow:GTSDocument`](gmeow-GTSDocument.md)) and for a single frame; never make one segment vouch for another — each keeps its own attestation by design.

### How to use

- [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md) it in its document with [`gmeow:gtsSegmentOf`](../properties/gmeow-gtsSegmentOf.md), order it with [`gmeow:gtsSegmentIndex`](../properties/gmeow-gtsSegmentIndex.md), commit its history with [`gmeow:gtsHeadId`](../properties/gmeow-gtsHeadId.md), declare its purpose with [`gmeow:gtsProfile`](../properties/gmeow-gtsProfile.md), and attach signatures as [`gmeow:hasSignature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSignature.md) / [`gmeow:Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) whose [`attestedSubject`](../properties/gmeow-attestedSubject.md) is this segment.
